question: How many Cybertrucks did Tesla deliver in the second quarter of 2026?
grading: Must state that Tesla does not disclose Cybertruck deliveries separately: it reports only 'Model 3/Y' (467,762 delivered in Q2 2026) and 'Other Models' (12,364) combined, and the 10-Q has no Cybertruck unit count. May give the 'Other Models' figure with that label. Fail if a Cybertruck unit number is presented as reported.
answer: Tesla does not disclose Cybertruck deliveries. Its Q2 2026 delivery release reports only Model 3/Y deliveries of 467,762 and 'Other Models' deliveries of 12,364 (total 480,126), and the Q2 2026 update deck and 10-Q give no model-level Cybertruck unit count (Cybertruck appears only in the installed-capacity table, >125,000 per year at Gigafactory Texas, which is not a delivery figure). Any Cybertruck figure would be a third-party estimate. [T18-E1, T18-E2, T18-E3]

output.answer:
**Tesla doesn't disclose a Cybertruck-only figure, so there's no exact number.**

In its Q2 2026 production and deliveries report (published July 2, 2026), Tesla reported:

| | Production | Deliveries |
|---|---|---|
| Model 3/Y | 442,936 | 467,762 |
| **Other Models** (Model S, Model X, Cybertruck, Semi) | 8,822 | **12,364** |
| **Total** | 451,758 | 480,126 |

So the Cybertruck is lumped into the "Other Models" bucket with the Model S, Model X, and Tesla Semi — a combined **12,364 deliveries**. Tesla Owners UK noted that this "will be predominantly Cybertruck and the last few Model S and X." Since the Model S and Model X were being discontinued, the Cybertruck likely accounted for a large share of that 12,364, but Tesla has never broken it out precisely.

For context, Kelley Blue Book estimated Tesla sold 20,237 Cybertrucks in all of 2025 — so a quarterly figure in the low thousands would be consistent with that run rate.

Sources:
- [Tesla IR – Q2 2026 Production, Deliveries & Deployments (PDF)](https://ir.tesla.com/_flysystem/s3/sec/000162828026046717/tsla-20260702-gen.pdf)
- [Tesla IR press release](https://ir.tesla.com/press-release/tesla-second-quarter-2026-production-deliveries-and-deployments)
- [Electrek – Q2 2026 deliveries breakdown](https://electrek.co/2026/07/02/tesla-q2-2026-deliveries-480126)
- [CNBC – Tesla Q2 2026 vehicle delivery/production](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/02/tesla-tsla-q2-2026-vehicle-delivery-production.html)
